headline: Conagra (CAG) Stock May Be Fairly Valued After Its Slide
summary: Conagra Brands stock has had a tough few years with the share price down 43.8% over three years, yet the current valuation checks suggest the stock may now be closer to fair value rather than clearly mispriced. The roughly 43.8% share price decline over three years points to weak recent shareholder returns and a market that has marked Conagra down compared with its past position. headline: Conagra Brands (CAG) Retires Its COO And Drops The Role Entirely
summary: Conagra Brands announced the retirement of long-serving Chief Operating Officer Tom McGough. The company plans to eliminate the COO role as part of a broader executive realignment. Burke Raine has been appointed to an expanded chief growth officer role overseeing key growth functions. For investors tracking NYSE:CAG, these leadership changes come at a time when the stock has faced pressure over longer periods.
